Switch


A generic device designed to close, or open, or both, one or more electric circuits. All switches are two terminal devices including grounding switches. The ACDCTerminal.connected at the two sides of the switch shall not be considered for assessing switch connectivity, i.e. only Switch.open, .normalOpen and .locked are relevant.

Switch

root anyOf Switch
Type: object

A generic device designed to close, or open, or both, one or more electric circuits. All switches are two terminal devices including grounding switches. The ACDCTerminal.connected at the two sides of the switch shall not be considered for assessing switch connectivity, i.e. only Switch.open, .normalOpen and .locked are relevant.

Ravens.cimObjectType

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal Terminal.SvPowerFlow SvPowerFlow Ravens.cimObjectType
Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "SvPowerFlow"

ACDCTerminal.connected

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal ACDCTerminal.connected
Type: boolean

The connected status is related to a bus-branch model and the topological node to terminal relation. True implies the terminal is connected to the related topological node and false implies it is not.
In a bus-branch model, the connected status is used to tell if equipment is disconnected without having to change the connectivity described by the topological node to terminal relation. A valid case is that conducting equipment can be connected in one end and open in the other. In particular for an AC line segment, where the reactive line charging can be significant, this is a relevant case.

Terminal.phases

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal Terminal.phases
Type: enum (of string)

Represents the normal network phasing condition. If the attribute is missing, three phases (ABC) shall be assumed, except for terminals of grounding classes (specializations of EarthFaultCompensator, GroundDisconnector, and Ground) which will be assumed to be N. Therefore, phase code ABCN is explicitly declared when needed, e.g. for star point grounding equipment.
The phase code on terminals connecting same ConnectivityNode or same TopologicalNode as well as for equipment between two terminals shall be consistent.

Must be one of:

  • "PhaseCode.ACN"
  • "PhaseCode.s2N"
  • "PhaseCode.N"
  • "PhaseCode.X"
  • "PhaseCode.BN"
  • "PhaseCode.s12N"
  • "PhaseCode.none"
  • "PhaseCode.s1"
  • "PhaseCode.AC"
  • "PhaseCode.ABC"
  • "PhaseCode.AB"
  • "PhaseCode.s1N"
  • "PhaseCode.BC"
  • "PhaseCode.XY"
  • "PhaseCode.ABCN"
  • "PhaseCode.C"
  • "PhaseCode.s12"
  • "PhaseCode.AN"
  • "PhaseCode.XYN"
  • "PhaseCode.ABN"
  • "PhaseCode.XN"
  • "PhaseCode.s2"
  • "PhaseCode.CN"
  • "PhaseCode.B"
  • "PhaseCode.A"
  • "PhaseCode.BCN"

ACDCTerminal.sequenceNumber

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal ACDCTerminal.sequenceNumber
Type: integer

The orientation of the terminal connections for a multiple terminal conducting equipment. The sequence numbering starts with 1 and additional terminals should follow in increasing order. The first terminal is the "starting point" for a two terminal branch.

Ravens.cimObjectType

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal Ravens.cimObjectType

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.Terminals Terminal IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf Switch Switch.SwitchPhase SwitchPhase IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf Switch Switch.SwitchPhase SwitchPhase IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf Switch Switch.SwitchPhase SwitchPhase IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf Switch Switch.SwitchPhase SwitchPhase IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

ConductingEquipment.SvStatus

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.SvStatus
Type: array

Array of SvStatus objects

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.SvStatus SvStatus
Type: object

State variable for status.

No Additional Properties

SvStatus.inService

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.SvStatus SvStatus SvStatus.inService
Type: boolean

The in service status as a result of topology processing. It indicates if the equipment is considered as energized by the power flow. It reflects if the equipment is connected within a solvable island. It does not necessarily reflect whether or not the island was solved by the power flow.

SvStatus.phase

root anyOf Switch ConductingEquipment.SvStatus SvStatus SvStatus.phase
Type: enum (of string)

The individual phase status. If the attribute is unspecified, then three phase model is assumed.

Must be one of:

  • "SinglePhaseKind.B"
  • "SinglePhaseKind.N"
  • "SinglePhaseKind.C"
  • "SinglePhaseKind.s2"
  • "SinglePhaseKind.A"
  • "SinglePhaseKind.s1"

Ravens.cimObjectType

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "SvStatus"

Must be one of:

  • "Switch"

Equipment.aggregate

root anyOf Switch Equipment.aggregate
Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

root anyOf Switch Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled
Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

Equipment.normallyInService

root anyOf Switch Equipment.normallyInService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Switch.locked

root anyOf Switch Switch.locked
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
<ul>
<li>locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.</li>
</ul>

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf Switch IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf Switch IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf Switch IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Equipment.aggregate

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Equipment.aggregate
Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled
Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

Switch.locked

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Switch.locked
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
<ul>
<li>locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.</li>
</ul>

Equipment.normallyInService

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Equipment.normallyInService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Ravens.cimObjectType

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Ravens.cimObjectType
Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "ProtectedSwitch"

Switch.open

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Switch.open
Type: boolean

The attribute tells if the switch is considered open when used as input to topology processing.

Equipment.inService

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Equipment.inService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Switch.normalOpen

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Switch.normalOpen
Type: boolean

The attribute is used in cases when no Measurement for the status value is present. If the Switch has a status measurement the Discrete.normalValue is expected to match with the Switch.normalOpen.

Switch.ratedCurrent

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Switch.ratedCurrent
Type: object or number

The maximum continuous current carrying capacity in amps governed by the device material and construction.
The attribute shall be a positive value.

Switch.retained

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Switch.retained
Type: boolean

Branch is retained in the topological solution. The flow through retained switches will normally be calculated in power flow.

Switch.switchOnCount

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Switch.switchOnCount
Type: integer

The switch on count since the switch was last reset or initialized.

Switch.switchOnDate

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch Switch.switchOnDate
Type: string

The date and time when the switch was last switched on.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf ProtectedSwitch IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Breaker

root anyOf Breaker
Type: object

A mechanical switching device capable of making, carrying, and breaking currents under normal circuit conditions and also making, carrying for a specified time, and breaking currents under specified abnormal circuit conditions e.g. those of short circuit.

Equipment.aggregate

root anyOf Breaker Equipment.aggregate
Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

root anyOf Breaker Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled
Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf Breaker IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

Switch.locked

root anyOf Breaker Switch.locked
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
<ul>
<li>locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.</li>
</ul>

Equipment.normallyInService

root anyOf Breaker Equipment.normallyInService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Ravens.cimObjectType

root anyOf Breaker Ravens.cimObjectType
Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "Breaker"

Switch.open

root anyOf Breaker Switch.open
Type: boolean

The attribute tells if the switch is considered open when used as input to topology processing.

Equipment.inService

root anyOf Breaker Equipment.inService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Switch.normalOpen

root anyOf Breaker Switch.normalOpen
Type: boolean

The attribute is used in cases when no Measurement for the status value is present. If the Switch has a status measurement the Discrete.normalValue is expected to match with the Switch.normalOpen.

Switch.ratedCurrent

root anyOf Breaker Switch.ratedCurrent
Type: object or number

The maximum continuous current carrying capacity in amps governed by the device material and construction.
The attribute shall be a positive value.

No Additional Properties

Switch.retained

root anyOf Breaker Switch.retained
Type: boolean

Branch is retained in the topological solution. The flow through retained switches will normally be calculated in power flow.

Switch.switchOnCount

Type: integer

The switch on count since the switch was last reset or initialized.

Switch.switchOnDate

root anyOf Breaker Switch.switchOnDate
Type: string

The date and time when the switch was last switched on.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf Breaker IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf Breaker IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf Breaker IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Equipment.aggregate

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch Equipment.aggregate
Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled
Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

Switch.locked

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch Switch.locked
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
<ul>
<li>locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.</li>
</ul>

Equipment.normallyInService

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch Equipment.normallyInService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Switch.retained

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch Switch.retained
Type: boolean

Branch is retained in the topological solution. The flow through retained switches will normally be calculated in power flow.

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch Switch.switchOnCount
Type: integer

The switch on count since the switch was last reset or initialized.

Switch.switchOnDate

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch Switch.switchOnDate
Type: string

The date and time when the switch was last switched on.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf LoadBreakSwitch IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf Recloser IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Cut

root anyOf Cut
Type: object

A cut separates a line segment into two parts. The cut appears as a switch inserted between these two parts and connects them together. As the cut is normally open there is no galvanic connection between the two line segment parts. But it is possible to close the cut to get galvanic connection.
The cut terminals are oriented towards the line segment terminals with the same sequence number. Hence the cut terminal with sequence number equal to 1 is oriented to the line segment's terminal with sequence number equal to 1.
The cut terminals also act as connection points for jumpers and other equipment, e.g. a mobile generator. To enable this, connectivity nodes are placed at the cut terminals. Once the connectivity nodes are in place any conducting equipment can be connected at them.

No Additional Properties

Equipment.aggregate

root anyOf Cut Equipment.aggregate
Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

Switch.locked

root anyOf Cut Switch.locked
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
<ul>
<li>locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.</li>
</ul>

Equipment.normallyInService

root anyOf Cut Equipment.normallyInService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Sectionaliser

root anyOf Sectionaliser
Type: object

Automatic switch that will lock open to isolate a faulted section. It may, or may not, have load breaking capability. Its primary purpose is to provide fault sectionalising at locations where the fault current is either too high, or too low, for proper coordination of fuses.

Branch is retained in the topological solution. The flow through retained switches will normally be calculated in power flow.

The switch on count since the switch was last reset or initialized.

Switch.switchOnDate

root anyOf Sectionaliser Switch.switchOnDate
Type: string

The date and time when the switch was last switched on.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf Sectionaliser IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf Sectionaliser IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf Sectionaliser IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Fuse

root anyOf Fuse
Type: object

An overcurrent protective device with a circuit opening fusible part that is heated and severed by the passage of overcurrent through it. A fuse is considered a switching device because it breaks current.

No Additional Properties

Equipment.aggregate

root anyOf Fuse Equipment.aggregate
Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf Fuse IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

root anyOf Fuse Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled
Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

Switch.locked

root anyOf Fuse Switch.locked
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
<ul>
<li>locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.</li>
</ul>

Equipment.normallyInService

root anyOf Fuse Equipment.normallyInService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Ravens.cimObjectType

root anyOf Fuse Ravens.cimObjectType
Type: enum (of string)

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

Must be one of:

  • "Fuse"

Switch.open

root anyOf Fuse Switch.open
Type: boolean

The attribute tells if the switch is considered open when used as input to topology processing.

Equipment.inService

root anyOf Fuse Equipment.inService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Switch.normalOpen

root anyOf Fuse Switch.normalOpen
Type: boolean

The attribute is used in cases when no Measurement for the status value is present. If the Switch has a status measurement the Discrete.normalValue is expected to match with the Switch.normalOpen.

Switch.ratedCurrent

root anyOf Fuse Switch.ratedCurrent
Type: object or number

The maximum continuous current carrying capacity in amps governed by the device material and construction.
The attribute shall be a positive value.

No Additional Properties

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf GroundDisconnector IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

Jumper

root anyOf Jumper
Type: object

A short section of conductor with negligible impedance which can be manually removed and replaced if the circuit is de-energized. Note that zero-impedance branches can potentially be modelled by other equipment types.

No Additional Properties

Equipment.aggregate

root anyOf Jumper Equipment.aggregate
Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf Jumper IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

root anyOf Jumper Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled
Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

Switch.locked

root anyOf Jumper Switch.locked
Type: boolean

If true, the switch is locked. The resulting switch state is a combination of locked and Switch.open attributes as follows:
<ul>
<li>locked=true and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open and locked;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=true. The resulting state is open;</li>
<li>locked=false and Switch.open=false. The resulting state is closed.</li>
</ul>

Equipment.normallyInService

root anyOf Jumper Equipment.normallyInService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Switch.open

root anyOf Jumper Switch.open
Type: boolean

The attribute tells if the switch is considered open when used as input to topology processing.

Equipment.inService

root anyOf Jumper Equipment.inService
Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

Switch.normalOpen

root anyOf Jumper Switch.normalOpen
Type: boolean

The attribute is used in cases when no Measurement for the status value is present. If the Switch has a status measurement the Discrete.normalValue is expected to match with the Switch.normalOpen.

Switch.ratedCurrent

root anyOf Jumper Switch.ratedCurrent
Type: object or number

The maximum continuous current carrying capacity in amps governed by the device material and construction.
The attribute shall be a positive value.
